structured.answer: If I must pick one: Harel (הראל), the "כספי (שקלי)" track. It says 0% shares, 4.25% over 3 years and a 0.57% fee, and Harel is a name I know. But I won't sign until I ask my son or the bank what "כספי" and "סחיר" mean.
